factories.name: newGetChannelStep
factories.description: Read one channel the bot can view by channel ID.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel's snowflake ID, 17 to 20 digits, from Copy Channel ID in Discord's Developer Mode.

factories.name: newListChannelMessagesStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of up to 100 channel messages, newest first, before or after a message ID.

inputSchema.description: ListChannelMessagesInput selects one page of a channel's messages. Discord returns messages newest first. Set at most one of BeforeMessageID and AfterMessageID: blank both reads the newest page, BeforeMessageID pages toward older messages, and AfterMessageID reads messages newer than it.

afterMessageId.description: AfterMessageID lists messages newer than this message ID.

beforeMessageId.description: BeforeMessageID lists messages older than this message ID, such as the previous page's OldestMessageID.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel's snowflake ID, 17 to 20 digits.

limit.description: Limit is the most messages returned, 1 to 100; zero returns up to 50.

factories.name: newCreateMessageStep
factories.description: Send one bot text message to a channel, deduplicated by a Discord nonce derived from the idempotency key, with every mention disabled.

inputSchema.description: CreateMessageInput sends one text message to a channel as the bot. Every mention is disabled, so text such as @everyone or <@id> renders but notifies nobody.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel's snowflake ID, 17 to 20 digits.

content.description: Content is the message text, 1 to 2000 characters and not only whitespace.

replyToMessageId.description: ReplyToMessageID makes the message a reply to this message in the same channel; blank sends a plain message.

factories.name: newAddReactionStep
factories.description: Add the bot's reaction with one emoji to a channel message; repeating it leaves one reaction.

inputSchema.description: AddReactionInput adds the bot's reaction to one message.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel's snowflake ID, 17 to 20 digits.

emoji.description: Emoji is a Unicode emoji such as 👍, or a custom emoji as name:id, such as party_blob:123456789012345678.

messageId.description: MessageID is the message's snowflake ID.
